en.title: 2026 Outlook: AI apps are getting harder to build—so where can ordinary people still make money?
en.summary: Funding for AI app startups is tightening, leaving many indie developers and founders unsure where to focus. This piece skips the crowded foundational infrastructure race and lays out two practical directions for ordinary people. Rather than chasing the latest tech hype, start with real consumer pain points close to home — and even non-experts can find an AI business opportunity that fits them.

en.summary: This piece unpacks a curious industry reversal: AI browsers, once hyped to the max, are ebbing, while the age-old TTY terminal is back in the mainstream for AI coding Agent work.
